blocks.title: Heat engine
blocks.text: Heat engine kuch thermal energy ko mechanical kaam mein badalta hai. Aam taur par heat eendhan jalne se aati hai. Sab se pehla heat engine steam engine tha, jo is haqeeqat par bana ke jab dhakkan se dhake bartan mein pani ubala jaye to andar ki bhaap dhakkan ko dhakelne ki koshish karti hai, kaam karne ki salahiyat dikhati hui; is mushahide ne steam engine banane mein madad di. Steam engine ek thermodynamical system hai (Do You Know).

Heat engine ka kaam karne ka usool cyclic amal ke zariye heat energy ki mechanical kaam mein tabdeeli par mabni hai. Is mein zyada temperature ke reservoir se kam temperature ke reservoir tak heat energy ki cyclic muntaqili shamil hai, zyada se zyada heat ko mechanical kaam mein badalne ke maqsad se. Yeh amal thermodynamic usoolon ke tahat hai aur un mukhtalif istemalat mein zaroori hai jahan heat ke zariyon se mechanical energy chahiye.

blocks.prompt: Heat engine ko cycle mein kyun chalna chahiye, aur jo heat kaam nahi banti woh kahan jati hai?
blocks.explanation: Sirf cyclic amal engine ko musalsal kaam dene deta hai, har bar working substance ko us ki shuru ki halat par wapas late hue taake ek cycle mein us ki internal energy ki tabdeeli sifr ho. Jo heat kaam mein nahi badalti woh kam temperature ke reservoir, mahol, ko di jati hai.

items: Heat engine: garam reservoir se thande reservoir tak heat ki cyclic muntaqili se thermal energy (aam taur par jalte eendhan se) ko mechanical kaam mein badalta hai; steam engine pehla tha.
